verdict.rationale: The only evidence of cross-OS use is one community user who supports a club's Windows 10 machine from Linux with AnyDesk. That suggests host and viewer can run on different operating systems, but there is no first-party platform list. A 2014 launch-era comment notes there was no Mac version at the time, which is too old to contradict current coverage. missing for 10: first-party documentation of supported desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux), any evidence of mobile clients (iOS/Android), documented cross-OS host/viewer compatibility, and broader independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: remote support for a club's Win10 machine from Linux moved from LogMeIn to TeamViewer (which also got breached) to AnyDesk
